newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Citibank Australia cuts home loan rate by 70 b.p.
newsitem.headline: Citibank Australia cuts home loan rate by 70 b.p.

text.p: Citibank Ltd said on Thursday that it had cut its standard mortgage variable rate by 0.7 percentage points, following Wednesday's 0.5 percentage point reduction in official interest rates by the Reserve Bank.
Citibank said in a statement that its new standard variable mortgage rate would be 6.99 percent, with the basic variable rate being 6.49 percent.

The rate cut would be effective immediately for new home loan and small business loan customers, and would take effect during September for existing customers, with the exact date depending upon customer's statement cycle date, Citibank said.
All other Citibank loan products were being reviewed, the bank said.
